approvals_consumption_consistent.name: approvals_consumption_consistent
approvals_consumption_consistent.value: ("approvals"."status" = 'consumed' and "approvals"."consumed_at" is not null) or ("approvals"."status" <> 'consumed' and "approvals"."consumed_at" is null)

messages_direction_timestamp_check.name: messages_direction_timestamp_check
messages_direction_timestamp_check.value: ("messages"."direction" = 'inbound' and "messages"."received_at" is not null) or ("messages"."direction" = 'outbound' and "messages"."sent_at" is not null)

pairing_challenges_consumption_consisten.name: pairing_challenges_consumption_consistent
pairing_challenges_consumption_consisten.value: ("pairing_challenges"."status" = 'consumed' and "pairing_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null) or ("pairing_challenges"."status" <> 'consumed' and "pairing_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)

action_executions_completion_consistent.name: action_executions_completion_consistent
action_executions_completion_consistent.value: ("action_executions"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed') and "action_executions"."completed_at" is not null) or ("action_executions"."status" in ('pending', 'running') and "action_executions"."completed_at" is null)

chain_memory_candidates_source_task_cons.name: chain_memory_candidates_source_task_consistent
chain_memory_candidates_source_task_cons.value: ("chain_memory_candidates"."source_stage" = 'task' and "chain_memory_candidates"."source_task_id" is not null) or ("chain_memory_candidates"."source_stage" in ('direct', 'synthesis') and "chain_memory_candidates"."source_task_id" is null)
